name: ue5-mcp
description: Battle-tested knowledge base for AI-assisted Unreal Engine 5 development via MCP (ECABridge). Covers the 400+ tool surface across UE 5.7 and 5.8, the server-side Python sandbox (execute_script + get_execution_environment) for collapsing multi-call workflows, schema-in-error validation responses, inline image screenshots, source control + observability categories, plus Niagara workarounds, MetaSound crash avoidance, and Blueprint wiring patterns.
